chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Whoever enters the Ka'bah with tranquility—that is, entering it without arrogance and without tyranny—will be forgiven."

key_terms.الْكَعْبَةَ: the Ka'bah, the sacred House of Allah visited during hajj
key_terms.بِسَكِينَةٍ: with tranquility, calmness, and composed humility
key_terms.غُفِرَ لَهُ: he will be forgiven by Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for entering the Ka'bah with humility and tranquility?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that entering the Ka'bah in a state of sakinah and humility is a cause of divine forgiveness. It emphasizes that worship is accepted with inward humbleness, free from pride and domineering conduct.
